info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Development Initiative-spec
info.description: The Business Development Initiative Management API enables organizations to create and manage strategic business development initiatives. This endpoint allows users to define and launch new initiatives aimed at enhancing market penetration and fostering business growth. Ideal for marketing teams and strategic planners, this API supports seamless integration with banking systems to track initiative performance and impact. Leverage this functionality to efficiently align projects with business objectives and capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new marketing initiative within the business development department, enabling the organization to innovate and implement new strategies effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new business development initiative within the marketing framework. It must include all required fields as defined in the schema.
